pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with smooth edge gradients due to pronounced motion blur. The spatial area of patches increases from the rump toward the neck, where they become more elongated and vertically oriented.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous topological graph of intersecting pathways with tri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness is relatively thin and uniform throughout the visible flank, though boundaries are poorly defined due to motion artifacts.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a high-frequency serrated 1D silhouette along the dorsal neck. The amplitude of the jagged peaks is low and softened by motion blur against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Three localized, high-contrast dark silhouettes consistent with avian forms are visible: one on the dorsal rump and two along the cervical-dorsal ridge.
